planets.name: Kepler-410 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-410 A with a 17.8-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-410 A b was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-410 A. Its orbit and size follow Van Eylen et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
